# Protected static final assignments

Three owned static final fields retain their sequential writes inside one checked catch region. The handler wraps the same original checked exception. Four frozen caller routes compare 96 cases twice, including same-thread observation of partial assignments, null results, checked/runtime/Error identity, initialization failure wrapping and cached failure on a second access.

Source and SDK-provider profiles compile all generated units and preserve field/method metadata. Six independent wrong programs verify the observer; native controls reject duplicate stores, malformed handler/field roles and broken call frames. Only owned initializer code executes.
